dcuniverse.msg.canalizando: Finish the ability before transforming back
dcuniverse.msg.energia_esgotada: Out of energy! Powers locked until 10% is back
dcuniverse.guia.passos.intro: This guide follows you through the DC Universe. Each task on the right gets checked on its own once you do it.
dcuniverse.guia.passos.teclas: G opens the guide, H turns you back to normal, Z, X, C, V and B use powers, R the supreme, Y the ability menu and an empty-hand click punches (Options > Controls).
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.transformar.desc: Use the Crystal of the House of El.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.sol.desc: Stand under the open sky by day.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.voar.desc: Press jump twice in the air.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.estrondo.desc: Fly forward while sprinting (Ctrl) until the boom.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.manobra.desc: While flying, double-tap A, D, S or W.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.destransformar.de: Press H or use the crystal.
dcuniverse.guia.personagens.vazio: No characters available on this server.
dcuniverse.guia.personagem.como_descobri: To discover this character, carry their transformation item, transform into them or see another player transformed.
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.sunlight: +%s per second in sunlight or near a Solar Chamber
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.flight: Flies: jump twice in the air; Ctrl speeds up; double-tap A/D to roll, S to turn around, W to dash
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.glide: Jumping in the air opens the cape to glide (jump again closes it)
item.dcuniverse.cristal_superman: Crystal of the House of El
personagem.dcuniverse.superman.exp: Absolute strength and power: you are the strongest person in the world, and the world must be handled with care.
dcuniverse.guia.passos.fim: You finished the First Steps! New tasks show up here as the mod grows.
dcuniverse.hud.demo.inicio: HUD demo: for 90 seconds a sample supreme appears on the HUD and is used by itself 4 seconds after it gets ready.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.radial.desc: Hold Y and release over an ability.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.habilidade.desc: Press or hold Z, X, C, V or B.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.combo.desc: With an empty hand, click four times in a row up to the finisher.
dcuniverse.guia.combo.como: Left click with an empty hand (or holding a block or a common item) to punch. Click again while the blow finishes to chain the next one: stored clicks go in as soon as possible, so you can keep the rhythm without rushing. Stopping for a moment restarts the combo. Each blow lunges at the enemy in front of you (up to %s blocks), on the ground or flying, and each hit freezes the blow for a split second with the impact. Aiming at a block with nobody in front, the click breaks the block; with a sword or tool in hand, it is the normal attack.
dcuniverse.guia.combo.area: Hits everyone within %s blocks, throws them far away and stuns for %s s
dcuniverse.guia.combo.lanca: Knocks the enemy into the air
dcuniverse.guia.combo.golpe.superman.dir: A straight right, turning the shoulder forward. Fast and precise, it opens the combo.
dcuniverse.guia.combo.golpe.superman.cru: The left crosses right after, with the body turning back. It keeps the enemy staggered in place.
dcuniverse.guia.combo.golpe.superman.gan: Clark dips and rises with a right uppercut that lifts the enemy off the ground, leaving them in the air for the finisher.
dcuniverse.guia.combo.golpe.superman.soc: The finisher: he pulls the arm back, steps in and unleashes all of Krypton's strength in a punch that bursts the air. It throws everyone in front far away; in the air, it sends the enemy where you look, even into the ground.
key.dcuniverse.radial: Ability menu (hold; release over one to use it)
dcuniverse.radial.vazio: This character has no abilities yet.
dcuniverse.guia.ficha.unidades: Health and damage in hearts; running, flight and gliding in blocks per second.
dcuniverse.guia.voo.detalhe: Cruise %s b/s. Holding Ctrl (boost) speed keeps rising up to %s b/s and the trail shows. The dash costs %s energy.
dcuniverse.guia.planar.detalhe: Cruise %s b/s with the cape open; curving down it reaches %s b/s and diving (Shift) %s b/s. Release Shift while fast to pull up into the sky. S brakes like a parachute, A/D turn, double-tap A/D barrel-rolls sideways (dodge) and double-tap W beats the cape for a boost that costs %s energy. Landing fast turns into a roll, with no fall damage.
dcuniverse.guia.hab.impacto: Explodes on impact: hits everything within %s blocks for half damage
habilidade.dcuniverse.visao_de_calor.des: Heat beams shoot from your eyes while you hold V. They burn enemies, light fires, campfires, candles, TNT and furnaces (no fuel needed) and melt every kind of ice and snow.
habilidade.dcuniverse.sopro_congelante.d: A cone of freezing air. It slows enemies, traps anyone caught in it for 1 s inside a block of ice, turns water into ice and lava into obsidian and puts out fires.
habilidade.dcuniverse.soco_sonico.desc: A punch so fast it releases a shockwave. It travels in a straight line and explodes on impact, throwing everything around it.
personagem.dcuniverse.superman.lore: Kal-El was born on Krypton, a planet on the brink of destruction. Just before the end, his father, Jor-El, sent him to Earth in a small ship. Raised by Jonathan and Martha Kent on a Smallville farm as Clark Kent, he discovered that the yellow sun gave him powers far beyond those of any human. Today he is a reporter at the Daily Planet in Metropolis and, in a red cape, protects the world as Superman, Earth's greatest hero.
dcuniverse.msg.sem_chao: You need to be near the ground
habilidade.dcuniverse.pisao_sismico.desc: A stomp so strong it cracks the ground. The shockwave runs out in a ring from you, throws enemies up and away and slows them all. It tears up the grass on its way. You must be on or very close to the ground.
habilidade.dcuniverse.visao_raio_x.desc: You see through blocks: ores, chests and monster spawners are marked in color and mobs get an outline, even behind walls. Only you see it.
habilidade.dcuniverse.fortaleza_da_solid: A Kryptonian crystal raises a crystal fortress from the ground where you aim, with its door facing you. Inside, the solar chamber heals every player and recharges the energy of anyone transformed, and monsters are pushed out. Allies can come in and use it. At the end it shatters and vanishes.
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.super_strength: Super strength: breaks stone and ore by hand
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.super_jump: Super jump: crouch and hold jump
dcuniverse.guia.salto.detalhe: Hold crouch and jump on the ground to charge (full charge in %2$s s) and release jump: up to about %1$s blocks high.
dcuniverse.guia.ricochete.detalhe: Arrows and other projectiles of up to %s ♥ deal no damage.
dcuniverse.guia.hab.cura: Inside: Regeneration %s and +%s energy per second
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.kryptonite: %s per second near kryptonite or carrying it, and loses super strength and ricochet
dcuniverse.guia.item.bloco_kryptonita: Nine shards packed together. Its aura weakens Kryptonians within 10 blocks: a good base defense in multiplayer.
dcuniverse.guia.item.camara_solar: Focuses sunlight into a crystal. Kryptonians within 6 blocks recharge as if under the sun, even at night or underground.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_kryptoniano: A crystal from Krypton that came inside the meteor. Ingredient of the Crystal of the House of El and the Solar Chamber.
One per Meteor Crater, in the chest hidden inside the meteor at the bottom of the crater.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_superman: Right-click to put on Superman's suit and gain his powers. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.guia.item.fragmento_alienigen: A piece of the meteor veined with energy. Used to craft another Hero's Guide and, in future versions, alien technology.
In the meteor chest at the bottom of Meteor Craters (2 to 4 per chest).
dcuniverse.guia.item.fragmento_kryptonit: A shard of kryptonite. Carrying one drains Superman's energy, gives Weakness and removes super strength.
Mine Kryptonite Ore (Fortune increases the amount) or break a Block of Kryptonite back into 9.
dcuniverse.guia.item.guia_heroi: This book. Right-click it or press G to open the tasks, the characters and every mod item with its recipe.
dcuniverse.guia.item.guia_heroi.obter: Every player gets one when joining the world for the first time.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_kryptonita: Green alien rock that glows in the dark. A transformed Superman loses energy and super strength within 6 blocks of it.
Underground from Y -60 to 0, and exposed in Meteor Craters. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better; Silk Touch drops the ore itself.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_1: An energy core that awakens powers. Tier I: base of early-game transformation items and of Core II.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_2: Tier II, with diamond and glowstone dust: base of tier 2 transformation items and of Core III.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_3: Tier III, with blaze rod, ender pearl and amethyst: base of tier 3 transformation items and of Core IV.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_4: Tier IV, the strongest, with netherite and crying obsidian from the Nether: base of end-game transformation items such as Superman's. Does not burn in lava.
dcuniverse.guia.item.tecido_tatico: Tough fabric with a kevlar weave. The base of every hero suit.
dcuniverse.guia.itens.abrir: Click to open in the guide
dcuniverse.guia.itens.sem_uso: Not an ingredient of anything yet.
personagem.dcuniverse.batman.lore: As a boy, Bruce Wayne watched his parents die in a Gotham alley. Heir to a fortune, he spent years travelling the world to train body and mind: martial arts, criminology, chemistry, engineering and the art of vanishing. Back in Gotham, he took up the symbol of the bat so that criminals would feel the same fear he felt that night. He has no superpowers: he wins because he prepares better than anyone, with the utility belt, the gadgets built in the Batcave and the vehicles made with Lucius Fox's help.
habilidade.dcuniverse.gancho.desc: Fires the grapnel where you aim. On a block, the cable pulls you there; hold jump as you arrive to be launched upward. On a small mob, it pulls the mob to you; on a big mob, it pulls you to it. Aim at the Batwing to board it. Use again or sneak to let go. No fall damage while the cable is attached.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue.desc: Throws a batarang that follows your aim, ricochets to the nearest mobs and comes back to your hand. On the way it cuts cobwebs, leaves, vines, tripwires and leads (freeing the leashed mob), presses buttons and pulls levers. Briefly slows the target.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_explosi: A batarang with an explosive charge: it blows up on the first mob or block it hits, hurting and pushing everything around without breaking blocks.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_eletric: A batarang with a battery: the shock paralyzes the target and arcs to up to 2 nearby mobs.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batwing.desc: The Batwing dives from the sky and stops beside you, and you board it. Fly with W (throttle), Ctrl (afterburner), S (brake and hover), A/D and the mouse. Hold left click to fire the guns (watch the heat), right click fires a homing missile at the target locked in your sights and V turns on stealth mode, which makes mobs lose track of you. Sneak to jump out; another player can board as a passenger. The grapnel also gets you back on board.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batmovel.desc: The Batmobile roars down the street and stops beside you (with no clear path it rolls out of a smoke cloud right there) and you board it. W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, A/D steer, Ctrl fires the turbo and Space pulls the handbrake to drift. Hold left click for the guns, right click launches a roof missile at the locked target and V electrifies the hull, shocking anyone close. Running enemies over hurts. Sneak to get out; a passenger rides in the other seat.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batmoto.desc: The Batcycle arrives at full throttle and you mount it. It is the fastest and most agile on the ground: W accelerates, S brakes, A/D lean into the turns, Ctrl fires the turbo and Space makes it jump. Hold left click for the guns, right click throws batarangs forward and V drops a smoke screen behind you that blinds whoever is chasing. Sneak to get off; a passenger rides on the back.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batbarco.desc: The Batboat surfaces near you (it needs deep water nearby) and you board it. On the surface it planes fast: W accelerates, S brakes, A/D turn and Ctrl fires the turbo. V dives and surfaces: underwater it follows your aim up and down, Space rises and you don't drown. Hold left click for the guns and right click fires a torpedo at the locked target. On land it barely crawls. Sneak to get out.
dcuniverse.msg.sem_cargas: %s: out of charges, the belt is making more
dcuniverse.msg.disruptor_sem_alvo: Disruptor: nothing to disarm in your sights
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.tech_station: +%s per second near a Batcomputer or Tech Charger, or while flying the Batwing; there gadgets recharge 3x faster
dcuniverse.guia.hab.cargas: Charges: %s. The belt makes 1 every %s s using %s energy
dcuniverse.guia.hab.ricochete: Ricochets to up to %s mobs and comes back
dcuniverse.guia.hab.choque: The shock arcs to up to 2 nearby mobs
dcuniverse.guia.hab.batwing.voo: Flies at %s blocks/s, %s blocks/s with afterburner
dcuniverse.guia.hab.batwing.armas: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Missiles: %s, %s ♥ each with a %s block radius, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.velocidade: Drives at %s blocks/s, %s blocks/s with turbo
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batmov: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Roof missiles: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batmot: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Batarangs: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batbar: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Torpedoes: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.atropelo: Runs enemies over from %s blocks/s: up to %s ♥ at top speed
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.especial.bat: Electric hull: %2$s ♥ and %3$s s of stun within %1$s blocks, every %4$s s
Smoke screen of %1$s blocks for %5$s s, every %4$s s
Dives and sails underwater at %6$s blocks/s without drowning
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.gancho.desc: As Batman, aim at a high block and press the grapple's shortcut.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.batarangue.desc: It comes back to your hand on its own.
dcuniverse.radial.sem_cargas: Out of charges: next in %s s
personagem.dcuniverse.batman.exp: Preparation, gear and strategy: you win because you planned, not because you are stronger.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cinto_batman: Right-click to put on Batman's suit and carry his gadgets. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.planar.desc: As Batman, press jump in the air.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.manobra_planar.de: While gliding, double-tap A, D or W, or dive with Shift and let go.
habilidade.dcuniverse.modo_detetive.desc: The cowl's visor analyzes everything around you. Press its shortcut to turn it on and again to turn it off. While on, you see mobs through walls (threats in red, others in blue, players in orange), each threat's weak point and health, other players' footprints, doors, levers, buttons, pressure plates and chests, and weak walls (cracked bricks and infested blocks) that explosive gel brings down. Hits and batarangs deal extra damage to mobs while it is on. Drains energy per second (none in creative) and turns itself off when it runs out.
habilidade.dcuniverse.bomba_fumaca.desc: Bursts a dense cloud of smoke at your feet. Anyone inside is blinded and slowed, and mobs lose sight of you, even those outside that were aiming at you. You get a few seconds of speed and invisibility to vanish.
habilidade.dcuniverse.gel_explosivo.desc: Aim at a nearby block and use the gel (shortcut or ability menu) to spread a gel charge on the wall. Sneak and use it again (or use it while aiming at nothing) to detonate: each charge beeps and blows in sequence, opening a round hole and hurting and pushing anyone nearby. Every broken block drops as an item; obsidian and bedrock never break.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_congela: A batarang with a nitrogen capsule: the target is trapped in a block of ice for 3 s (players and bosses are only slowed) and nearby fire goes out. Over water it freezes its path and the impact point into ice that melts on its own: you can cross a river running after it.
On impact (or at the end of its range) it releases a 6-block sonic pulse: everyone around is stunned, slowed and weakened, and mobs lose sight of you. Bats, silverfish and endermites take far more damage, and nearby glass shatters. It does not come back.
habilidade.dcuniverse.lancador_rede.desc: Fires a net that opens in the air. On a hit it wraps the target in real cobwebs and holds it for 6 s. On a wall or the floor it becomes a 3x3 cobweb trap for 15 s. The webs vanish on their own and drop no string.
habilidade.dcuniverse.disruptor.desc: An electronic pulse at your crosshair, up to 32 blocks. The target is shocked and paralyzed for 2 s and disarmed: the weapon in a mob's hand (bow, crossbow, trident, sword or axe) burns out, and a creeper loses its fuse for 10 s. Lit TNT near the crosshair goes out and drops as a block. With nothing to disarm, no charge is spent.
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.stealth: Stealth: sneaking in the dark, mobs only notice you up close
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.counter: Counter: sneak (or raise your shield) right as a hit comes to cancel it and strike back
dcuniverse.guia.furtividade.detalhe: Works at light level %s or less; mobs see you %s%% less far. The screen edges darken while you are hidden
dcuniverse.guia.contra.detalhe: %s s window before the hit. Strikes back for %s ♥, stuns for %s s and knocks back; projectiles fly back at the shooter. Mistimed: wait %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.dreno: Drains %s energy per second while on. Weak points: +%s%% damage to mobs
dcuniverse.guia.hab.fumaca: Blinds those inside for %s s; you get %s s of speed and invisibility
dcuniverse.guia.hab.gel: Up to %s charges placed at once. Sneak and use it again to detonate
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.detetive.desc: As Batman, press Detective Mode's shortcut.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.gel.desc: Aim at a nearby wall and use the gel.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.gel_detonar.desc: Sneak and use the gel again.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.contra_ataque.des: Sneak right as a mob is about to hit you.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.furtivo.desc: Sneaking in the dark, stay near a monster without it seeing you.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.dica: Click the card to choose it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.escolhi: This is the one your supreme calls.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batwing: Flies over everything, hovers and fires homing missiles. Stealth mode drops off the mobs' radar.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batmove: Heavy and tough: drifts on the handbrake, runs enemies over, fires roof missiles and electrifies its hull.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batmoto: The fastest on the ground: jumps, leans into turns, throws batarangs and drops smoke behind it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batbarc: Planes over water and dives to sail underwater. Fires torpedoes. Needs deep water nearby.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.sem_her: No tech suit detected. Put on the Utility Belt and the Batcomputer will refill your gadgets and energy at once. The other tabs work for anyone.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.dica: Pick a slot, then click a gadget
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.vazio.d: Click a gadget in the arsenal to store it here. Click the gadget already in the slot (or right-click the pouch) to remove it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.sem_cin: No hero with a utility belt in this world.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.analise.falta: Not enough data. Carry a sample (%s) and analyze it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.mapa.alcance: %s-block radius, from what your eyes have already loaded.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.zombie: Slow and tough; burns in daylight. Also covers drowned, husks and zombie villagers.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.skeleton: Archer: close the distance or use cover. Burns in daylight. Covers strays and bogged.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.spider: Climbs walls and only attacks in the dark. Covers the poisonous cave spider.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.creeper: Explodes up close: hit and back off. Lightning makes it charged and far stronger.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.enderman: Teleports and hates eye contact. Water hurts it: fight in the rain or near water.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.slime: Splits when it dies. Take out the small ones first or stay up high.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.phantom: Hunts those who skip sleep. Burns in daylight; sleeping prevents it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.guardian: Slow-charging laser: break line of sight. Covers the elder guardian.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.zombifie: Neutral until attacked, then the whole pack comes. Avoid stray hits.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.magma_cu: Immune to fire and lava. Jumps high and splits like a slime.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.blaze: Ranged fireballs. Snowballs and water hurt it; immune to fire.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.ghast: Fragile but far away. Hit its fireball back at it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.breeze: Deflects projectiles and fires wind charges. Melee works best.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.wither_s: Its hits inflict Wither. Tall: a 2-block gap keeps it out.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.shulker: Shots that make you levitate. Strike when its shell opens.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.capa_planador.des: Put the cape on your chest and jump in midair to glide.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.visor_tatico.desc: Keep the visor on your head for 10 s.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.cinto.desc: At the Batcomputer, Gadgets tab: swap a gadget into a slot.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.garagem.desc: At the Batcomputer, Garage tab: pick another vehicle and call it with the supreme.
dcuniverse.guia.item.batarangue_simples: Throwable that comes back to your hand (2 damage). Anyone can use it: it cuts webs and leaves and presses buttons from afar. It returns to your inventory, or drops if you miss the catch.
dcuniverse.guia.item.batcomputador: Batman's command center. Gadgets: refills the belt and energy at once (every 60 s). Fabricate: makes tech parts straight from your inventory. Analysis: a mob sample reveals its file and you deal +15% damage to that type. Map: the terrain around with threats and players. It is also a recharge station.
dcuniverse.guia.item.capa_planador: Wear it on your chest to glide like Batman: jump in midair to open it, dive to gain speed and pull up to climb. Double-tap W for a boost that tires you (costs hunger); double-tap A/D to roll and hold S to brake.
dcuniverse.guia.item.carregador_tecnolog: Recharge station: tech heroes nearby regain energy faster and the belt makes charges 3 times quicker. Use the Tactical Visor or the Grappling Hook on it to recharge them (costs 1 redstone).
dcuniverse.guia.item.componente_tecnolog: Mechanical and electronic part that builds gadgets, the Batcomputer and the Utility Belt.
dcuniverse.guia.item.gancho_escalada: Batman's grapple without powers: right-click fires up to 30 blocks and pulls you there; click again to let go. Each shot uses 1 of 200 uses, and it recharges at the Tech Charger.
dcuniverse.guia.item.lingote_prometio: Nearly indestructible metal, the base of heavy tech: energy cores today, top-tier armor later.
dcuniverse.guia.item.lingote_prometio.ob: Smelt Promethium Ore in a furnace or, twice as fast, in a blast furnace.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_prometio: Rare ore from the bottom of the world, locked in deepslate. It glows faintly in the dark and only drops with a diamond pickaxe.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_prometio.ob: Mine deepslate between Y -60 and -30, in small veins of 1 to 3 blocks (very rare).
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_energia: Promethium battery that stores plenty of energy. Powers the Tech Charger and energy armors.
dcuniverse.guia.item.placa_circuito: The brain of every device. It also repairs the Tactical Visor at an anvil.
dcuniverse.guia.item.visor_tatico: Tactical helmet: night vision and hostile mobs within 24 blocks outlined in red, with a threat count on screen. A charge lasts 30 minutes of use; recharge it at the Tech Charger or repair it with a Circuit Board.
dcuniverse.cmd.local_nao_achado: Could not find %s in this world.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.smallville.desc: The small Kansas town where Clark Kent grew up lies near the world spawn. Use /locate structure dcuniverse:smallville if you need help.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.nave_kalel.desc: Jonathan Kent hid the ship that brought the baby from Krypton somewhere on the Kent Farm.
dcuniverse.guia.item.osso_cristal: An ordinary bone wrapped in a Kryptonian crystal that glows from within. It is the only treat Krypto the Superdog accepts: give him one to tame him (one Krypto per player). If he is hurt, another bone heals him completely.
dcuniverse.guia.item.osso_cristal.obter: Crafted from a Bone and a Kryptonian Crystal. Martha Kent also gives you one when you accept the mission "A Four-Legged Friend".
dcuniverse.mascote.ja_tem: You already have a %s. Only one per hero!
dcuniverse.mascote.krypto.osso: Krypto sniffs the bone and turns up his nose. He only accepts a Kryptonian Crystal Bone.
dcuniverse.npc.beneficio.2: special trades and stories only told to friends
dcuniverse.npc.beneficio.4: the best-kept secrets and full trust
dcuniverse.npc.op.presente: Give the held item as a gift
dcuniverse.npc.missoes: I've got a few things you could help with:
dcuniverse.npc.sem_missoes: I don't need anything right now. Come back another day!
dcuniverse.npc.aceitou: Thank you so much! I'm counting on you for "%s".
dcuniverse.npc.falta: Something is still missing. Check your Journal (J).
dcuniverse.npc.trocas: Take a look at what I've got:
dcuniverse.npc.falta_itens: Hmm, you don't have enough for that trade.
dcuniverse.npc.mao_vazia: Hold what you want to give me in your hand.
dcuniverse.npc.nao_gostou: How kind... but %s isn't really my thing.
dcuniverse.npc.presente_hoje: You already gave me a gift today! Save %s for tomorrow.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi: Hello, dear! Come in, the pie just came out of the oven.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.0: Hello! You must be new around here. I'm Martha Kent, welcome to our farm.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.3: So good to see you again! I've already set an extra plate.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.4: My dear! You're part of this family now.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.superman: Clark! Back for dinner? Take that cape off before you sit down.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.batman: My, what a dark outfit! You must be Clark's friend. Coffee?
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.oi.heroi: A hero in my kitchen! Make yourself at home, heroes eat too.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.bronca: Hey! That's no way to behave. In my house we respect each other.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.sem_missoes: You've helped me plenty today. Get some rest!
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.trocas: From my kitchen to you. Bring me the ingredients and I'll cook:
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.sobre: Clark Kent's adoptive mother. With Jonathan she found the ship that fell on the farm fields and raised the boy with love, teaching him to use his gifts for good. She knows every corner of Smallville and loves helping newcomers.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.guia: That book you carry is the Hero's Guide. Press G to open it: it has tasks, characters and recipes.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.transfor: To become a hero, use the character's crystal. Clark kept his in a little box under his bed.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.radial: Each power has its own key: Z, X, C, V and B, and the supreme on R. Whatever doesn't fit goes in the ability menu: hold Y and release over the power. And with an empty hand, your mouse click becomes a punch.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.energia: Powers use energy. Clark recharges in the sun; each hero has their own way. Keep an eye on the bar.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.voo: When Clark learned to fly, he broke half the barn's shingles. Jump twice to take off and sprint to speed up.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.diario: Write down everything you promised to do. Press J to open the Mission Journal and pick the one to follow.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.afinidad: In a small town everybody knows each other. Help people, bring a gift, and they'll come to trust you.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.krypto: There's a white dog roaming the farm. I think he's looking for an owner... and a special treat.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.fazenda: This farm has been in the Kent family for four generations. The cornfields hide more stories than you'd think.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.jonathan: Jonathan used to say Clark was sent here to do good. I miss him every day when the sun sets over the field.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.nave: I'll tell you a secret: the ship Clark arrived in is still here. Jonathan hid it under the barn.
dcuniverse.npc.martha_kent.fala.clark: He carries the world on his shoulders, but to me he'll always be my boy. Look after him for me, okay?
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi: Hi! Welcome to the Talon. Today's coffee is great.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi.0: Hi, I'm Lana. First time at the Talon? Sit down, the first coffee is on me.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi.4: I'm so glad you came. The Talon isn't the same without you.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi.superman: Clark? No... just someone who looks like him. But that S reminds me of someone I know.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi.batman: A Gotham hero in Smallville? The most dangerous thing here is the espresso.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.oi.heroi: Wow, a real hero at the Talon! Can I take a picture for the wall?
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.bronca: Ouch! Do that again and you'll be off coffee forever.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.gostou: %s? How sweet! I'll keep it on the counter for everyone to see.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.sobre: Owner of the Talon, the coffee shop in Smallville's old cinema, and Clark Kent's childhood friend. She lost her parents in the meteor shower and wears a necklace made from one of the green stones. Curious and brave, she has always suspected Smallville hides something.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.talon: The Talon used to be an old cinema. I convinced the town not to tear it down and turned it into a café.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.cratera: The crater is outside town. They say the stones glow green at night. Be careful if you go there.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.colar: This necklace? It's a meteor stone. Funny... Clark always turns pale when he gets close to it.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.clark: Clark is... complicated. He always disappears when something happens and comes back with a bad excuse.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.meteoros: I was three when the meteors fell. It was the day I lost my parents.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.cidade: After the meteors, strange things started happening here. People changed. Some gained... gifts.
dcuniverse.npc.lana_lang.fala.segredo: Sometimes I think Clark is hiding something huge. And sometimes I think I'd rather not know.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi: Good morning! Fine day to be in Smallville.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.0: Hello, stranger. I don't see your face around here often.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.3: Look who it is! The whole town speaks well of you.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.4: You're practically a Kent by now. Smallville owes you a lot.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.superman: It's Superman! Wait till I tell the folks at the store!
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.batman: Hey... you're not from around here, are you? That bat on your chest isn't very Kansas.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.oi.heroi: A hero in Smallville! Lately we get one a week.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.bronca: Hey! Cut that out! I'll call the sheriff!
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.sobre: Simple, hardworking folk: farmers, shopkeepers, the Smallville Ledger newsboy and the sheriff. Help with everyday chores and the whole town will welcome you with open arms.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.tempo: The sky is clear, but they say a storm is coming from the west. Best bring in the hay.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.kents: The Kents are the finest people I've ever known. Martha makes the best apple pie in the county.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.meteoro: I remember the meteor shower well. The sky turned green and the town was never the same.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.talon: Been to the Talon yet? Lana serves the best coffee in Smallville.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.herois: They say a flying man saved the school bus last week. I don't doubt anything anymore.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.profissao: Here everybody helps everybody. That's how a small town works.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao.fala.segredo: I'll tell you: the Kent boy runs faster than the tractor. But I didn't see a thing, okay?
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao_fazendeiro.fala.p: Corn, wheat, pumpkins... Plant with patience and the land pays you back twice over.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao_fazendeira.fala.p: I wake up before the rooster. A farm waits for no one.
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao_jornaleiro.fala.p: Extra, extra! The Smallville Ledger has the freshest news. Want the gossip?
dcuniverse.npc.cidadao_xerife.fala.profi: I keep the peace in this town. At night monsters come from the fields; I need all the help I can get.
The General Store has a bit of everything. If I don't have it, I'll order it from Metropolis.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_ovos.desc: Martha needs 6 eggs for the family breakfast.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_ovos.pedido: The hens are scattered all over the farm. Could you bring me 6 eggs? I'll bake you some warm bread.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_ovos.aceita: Thank you, dear! The henhouse is behind the house.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_ovos.fim: Perfect! Here, some warm bread and a slice of pie.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_krypto.desc: A white dog roams the Kent farm. Give him the Kryptonian Crystal Bone Martha gave you.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_krypto.pedido: That white dog hasn't left the farm since Clark was a boy. He refuses any bone... except this one. Want to try?
dcuniverse.missao.martha_krypto.aceita: Take this Crystal Bone. He usually hangs around the barn.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_krypto.fim: Krypto chose you! Take good care of him: he flies by your side and fetches whatever you drop.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_krypto.fala.1: I saw it from the window! Krypto won't leave your side now.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_streaky.desc: An orange cat with a lightning mark showed up on the roof. Get 3 cod and win over Streaky.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_streaky.pedido: Now an orange cat showed up, with a yellow lightning mark. He keeps jumping off the roof... and doesn't fall! He loves fish.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_streaky.aceita: Catch some cod at the lake and call Streaky with them.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_streaky.fim: Streaky purring in your lap! Creepers will run from you now.
dcuniverse.missao.martha_streaky.fala.2: There's something special about that cat, isn't there? Just like Krypto.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_cafe.desc: Lana is out of ingredients for the Talon's hot chocolate.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_cafe.pedido: The supplier is late again and I have nothing for the hot chocolate. Could you bring me cocoa, sugar and a bucket of milk?
dcuniverse.missao.lana_cafe.aceita: You saved my day! Cocoa grows in jungles, but traders sometimes have it.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_cafe.fim: Hot chocolate for the whole town! Take some cookies on the house.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_pedras.desc: Lana wants to study the green stones from the Meteor Crater. Bring 3 Kryptonite Fragments.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_pedras.pedido: I want to understand what the meteors did to this town. Would you go to the crater and get some green stones for me?
dcuniverse.missao.lana_pedras.aceita: Be careful! They say those stones are harmful to some people.
dcuniverse.missao.lana_pedras.fim: They really glow... And this crystal came in with them, with a crest a lot like Superman's. I think it belongs to someone who fell from the sky with the meteors. Keep it, this stays between us.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_lenha.desc: A farmer needs 16 logs to get through the cold.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_lenha.pedido: Kansas winters are harsh. Could you bring me 16 logs? I'll pay in emeralds.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_lenha.aceita: Any wood will do. There's a grove just to the north.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_lenha.fim: Now the fireplace won't go out! Thanks, friend.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_colheita.desc: A farmer needs wheat and carrots for the market.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_colheita.pedid: The market is tomorrow and the harvest is late. Help me with 10 wheat and 6 carrots?
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_colheita.aceit: You can harvest from the fields, just replant afterwards!
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_colheita.fim: The stall will look great! Take some pumpkin pies.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.desc: The newsboy wants the latest from town: talk to Lana and Martha.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.pedido: I need news for tomorrow's edition! Will you ask Lana and Martha what's new?
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.fim: Front page guaranteed! The Smallville Ledger thanks you.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.fala.0: News? The Talon is having live music night on Friday!
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.fala.1: Tell the paper Martha's pie won the fair again. But don't exaggerate!
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_jornal.fala.2: What a story! I can already see the headline.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_pragas.desc: The sheriff asks for help driving 6 monsters out of Smallville.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_pragas.pedido: Every night monsters come out of the cornfields and scare the town. Take down 6 of them inside Smallville and come talk to me.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_pragas.aceita: Keep watch after sundown. Good luck!
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_pragas.fim: The town sleeps easier thanks to you. Here's your share.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_pragas.fala.1: Good work out there. Smallville thanks you.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_estoque.desc: The shopkeeper wants 32 torches you crafted to sell at the store.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_estoque.pedido: Torches flew off the shelves! Craft 32 and bring them to me, I'll pay well.
dcuniverse.missao.cidadao_estoque.fim: Shelves full again! It's a deal.
dcuniverse.guia.missoes.nenhuma: No active missions. Talk to the people of Smallville to get one.
dcuniverse.guia.missoes.nenhuma_concluid: You haven't completed any missions yet.
dcuniverse.guia.missoes.intro: Missions the residents give you are written down here, with every objective and reward.
dcuniverse.guia.missoes.como: The tracked mission shows in the corner of the screen with an arrow pointing where to go.
dcuniverse.guia.npcs.vazio: You don't know anyone yet. Right-click a Smallville resident to talk.
dcuniverse.guia.npcs.intro: Everyone you meet gets a page here.
dcuniverse.guia.npcs.ganhar: Earn affinity through missions, gifts (one a day) and protecting the town from monsters.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.conversar_npc.des: Right-click someone in Smallville to talk. Start with Martha Kent at the farm.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.missao_aceitar.de: In a conversation, choose Missions and accept a request. It shows up in the Journal (J key).
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.missao_concluir.d: Finish every objective and come back for your reward.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.trocar_npc.desc: Residents trade items with you. Higher affinity means more trades and better prices.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.presente_npc.desc: Hold something they like and choose Give as a gift. One per person each day.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.domar_krypto.desc: The Superdog roams the Kent Farm and only accepts a Kryptonian Crystal Bone.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.domar_streaky.des: The Supercat lives on the Kents' roof. Offer him fish.
dcuniverse.guia.item.comunicador_liga: Pocket radio bearing the Justice League symbol. Right-click another player to link the two of you (again to unlink). Linked allies who also carry a communicator show at the top of the screen with direction and distance. Right-click in the air to mark a meeting point where you aim (up to 160 blocks): it shows for you and your allies.
dcuniverse.guia.item.comunicador_liga.ob: Crafted from a Circuit Board, two Copper Ingots and an Ender Pearl. Martha Kent also gives one when you finish the mission "The First Emblem".
dcuniverse.missao.meteoro_smallville.des: Strange lights fell near the old Meteor Crater. Investigate the crater, gather 3 Alien Fragments and show the discovery to Martha.
dcuniverse.missao.meteoro_smallville.ped: Did you see those lights in the sky last night? They looked like the meteor shower from years ago... the same night Clark arrived. Could you take a look at the crater for me?
dcuniverse.missao.meteoro_smallville.ace: The crater is outside town: follow the arrow from your Journal. Be careful, and bring me whatever you find.
dcuniverse.missao.meteoro_smallville.fim: This metal... it matches the ship Jonathan hid in the barn. Something is calling you, dear. Here, fresh bread for the road.
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.desc: Martha thinks you can do good, like Clark. Craft a Meta-Human Core I, use it to make a level 1 transformation item and suit up for the first time.
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.pedid: Clark wasn't born knowing how to be a hero; he chose to be one. These fragments gave me an idea. Want to find out what you can do?
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.aceit: Take this fabric: I sewed it from what was left of Clark's blanket. The recipes are in your Guide (G key).
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.obj.0: Craft a Meta-Human Core I (iron, gold and redstone)
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.obj.1: Craft a level 1 transformation item (like the Utility Belt)
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.obj.2: Use the item and transform for the first time
Look at you! Jonathan would be proud.
dcuniverse.missao.primeiro_emblema.fim: This came in the mail, with your name on it. It has the Justice League symbol... I think the world already knows about you.
dcuniverse.missao.colheita_familia.desc: Martha needs help with the Kent farm harvest: 32 wheat and 8 pumpkins.
dcuniverse.missao.colheita_familia.pedid: The harvest waits for no one, and this back isn't what it used to be. Would you help me with 32 wheat and 8 pumpkins?
dcuniverse.missao.colheita_familia.aceit: The farm fields are ready to pick. Replant what you harvest, okay?
dcuniverse.missao.colheita_familia.fim: Jonathan used to say honest work feeds the soul. Take these golden carrots, the best in the garden. And this jacket is Conner's: he left it here last time, and you have the same way about you.
dcuniverse.cena.chuva_meteoros: ☄ A meteor shower! The fragments fell around the crater.
dcuniverse.liga.vinculado: League Communicator: you and %s are now linked.
dcuniverse.liga.desvinculado: League Communicator: your link with %s was removed.
dcuniverse.liga.ponto_so: Meeting point marked ◆ (no linked allies nearby)
dcuniverse.liga.longe: Too far to mark a point.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.liga_vincular.des: Right-click another player with the League Communicator to link the two of you.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.liga_ponto.desc: Right-click in the air with the League Communicator to mark where the team should gather.
personagem.dcuniverse.supergirl.lore: Kara Zor-El was thirteen when Krypton began to die. Her father, Zor-El, brother of Jor-El, sent her to Earth to look after her baby cousin, Kal-El. But Kara's ship was knocked off course and drifted asleep in space for decades. When she finally arrived, the baby was already a grown man: Superman. Under the yellow sun Kara gained the same powers as her cousin and a style all her own: faster, more impulsive and always the first to fly into the fight. Today she protects Earth as Supergirl and keeps the ship that carried her, made of crystal from the House of Zor-El.
personagem.dcuniverse.superboy.lore: Conner Kent was born in a Project Cadmus lab: a clone made from Superman's DNA and Lex Luthor's. He broke out of his tank as a teenager, with a leather jacket and a hurry to prove who he was. He doesn't have all of Superman's powers: instead of heat vision and freeze breath he has tactile telekinesis, the power to move anything he touches, even the ground under his feet. The Kents took him in at Smallville, where he learned that a hero isn't defined by where he came from, but by what he chooses to do.
habilidade.dcuniverse.investida_aerea.de: Kara shoots toward your crosshair like a missile, leaving a blue and red trail, up to 24 blocks in an instant. Anyone in the way takes a heavy hit and is flung far; leaves, glass, snow and cobwebs shatter as she passes. The rush stops when it hits a wall. Works from the ground (you take off) and in flight.
habilidade.dcuniverse.nave_kryptoniana.d: The crystal ship of the House of Zor-El comes down from the sky and you board it. Fly it like the Batwing: W speeds up, Ctrl boosts, S brakes and hovers, A/D and the mouse steer. Hold left click to fire the solar cannon, a heat beam from the nose that hurts, sets fire and melts ice, snow and sand (it heats up: let it cool). Right click launches a solar orb that chases the target locked in your crosshair and bursts in light. V raises the crystal shield: while it has charge, nothing hurts anyone inside, arrows and projectiles fly back at whoever shot them and monsters are pushed away. Sneak to jump out; another player can ride as a passenger.
habilidade.dcuniverse.telecinese_tatil.d: Tears out of the ground or wall, where you aim, a chunk of up to 3x3 blocks and 2 deep, which floats in front of you wrapped in blue light and follows your gaze. Use it again to throw the blocks at your crosshair: they hurt and knock back whatever they hit and settle where they land. Sneaking, use it again to set them down in the same shape where you aim (good for building). Sneaking with nothing held, telekinesis crumbles the aimed chunk and the blocks go straight into your inventory. Can't move bedrock, obsidian, liquids, chests or doors.
habilidade.dcuniverse.escudo_telecinetic: Conner wraps himself in a bubble of telekinetic force for 10 s. It absorbs 75% of damage, sends arrows and projectiles back at whoever shot them and pushes away monsters that come close. Use it again to drop it early.
Conner tears out of the ground, where you aim, a 5-block-radius disc of earth with everything on top of it (grass, flowers, small trees), and it rises with you standing in the middle. Fly it: W/A/S/D move where you look, jump goes up, Ctrl goes down; it's heavy and picks up speed slowly. Friends, mobs and items on top travel along. V sets the island down where it is, block by block; sneak to step off and use the supreme again to get back on. When time runs out it lands by itself.
dcuniverse.msg.ilha_sem_terreno: Island: no solid ground in your crosshair
dcuniverse.ilha.assentou: The island settled on the ground
dcuniverse.ilha.dica1: WASD move  Jump up  Ctrl down
dcuniverse.guia.hab.nave.canhao: Solar cannon: %s ♥ every 0.25 s, up to %s blocks, sets fire
dcuniverse.guia.hab.nave.orbes: Solar orbs: %s, of %s ♥ with a %s-block radius, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.nave.escudo: Crystal shield: lasts %s s up and recharges in %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.escudo_tk: Absorbs %s%% of damage in a %s-block bubble
dcuniverse.guia.hab.telecinese: Up to %s blocks at once, held for up to %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.ilha: Carries up to %s blocks and moves at %s blocks/s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.investida: Rushes at %s blocks/s and flings with force %s
item.dcuniverse.cristal_supergirl: Crystal of the House of Zor-El
personagem.dcuniverse.supergirl.exp: A faster, more impulsive Kryptonian: more speed and aerial combat, less brute strength.
personagem.dcuniverse.superboy.exp: Half Kryptonian: tactile telekinesis instead of heat vision.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_supergirl: Right-click to put on Supergirl's suit and gain her powers. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.guia.item.jaqueta_conner: Right-click to put on Superboy's suit and gain his powers. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.coleira.ja_tem_capa: He already has his own cape!
dcuniverse.coleira.ja_usa: It is already wearing an S Collar.
dcuniverse.coleira.conquista: Man of Steel's Best Friend! You got an S Collar to dress a tamed dog or cat.
dcuniverse.guia.item.coleira_s: A leather collar with a little red cape and the S shield, just like Krypto's. Right-click a dog or cat you tamed to put it on: the cape sways as it runs. Krypto and Streaky already have their own capes. Use shears on the animal to take the collar back; if it dies, the collar drops.
dcuniverse.guia.item.coleira_s.obter: Given once when you tame Krypto (advancement "Man of Steel's Best Friend"). After that, Martha Kent trades more (affinity 50): 3 Leather, 1 Red Wool and 1 Gold Ingot.
dcuniverse.guia.item.torta_martha: Martha Kent's famous apple pie, with a golden lattice and still warm. Eating one fills 8 hunger and gives Regeneration I for 10 seconds. On Kryptonian heroes (Superman, Supergirl, Superboy) it also restores 10% energy. Stacks to 16.
dcuniverse.guia.item.torta_martha.obter: Shapeless craft from an Apple, a Wheat, a Sugar and an Egg. Martha Kent also trades: 6 Wheat, 3 Apples and 1 Egg for 2 pies.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cinto_batman.obter: Crafted (tier 1 recipe, no Nether needed). It can also be your starting item.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_supergirl.o: Reward of Lana Lang's mission "Glowing Stones" in Smallville. It can also be your starting item or be crafted.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_superman.ob: In Kal-El's ship, in the basement of the Kent Farm barn in Smallville: right-click it (one per player). It can also be your starting item or be crafted.
dcuniverse.guia.item.jaqueta_conner.obte: Reward of Martha Kent's mission "Family Harvest" in Smallville. It can also be your starting item or be crafted.
dcuniverse.inicio.subtitulo: Choose where your story begins and with which hero.
dcuniverse.inicio.ganhou: You received: %s. Right-click it to transform.
dcuniverse.inicio.sem_local: %s could not be found in this world. Choose another place.
dcuniverse.mapa.dica: Mouse wheel zooms, drag to move. M closes.
dcuniverse.mapa.reservado: Still being built: coming in a future version.
dcuniverse.nave_kalel.cristal: The ship's cockpit opens and, inside, the Crystal of the House of El glows, waiting for you.
dcuniverse.nave_kalel.vazia: Kal-El's ship hums softly. The cockpit is empty.
dcuniverse.diretor.entrou: Director Mode: WASD, space and shift move the camera, Ctrl speeds up, the mouse wheel changes speed, [ and ] control slow motion. F6 exits.
dcuniverse.diretor.sem_permissao: Slow motion is only for players who can use commands in this world.
dcuniverse.flashback.explica: Flashback (by Moulberry) records replays for editing videos. It can't ship inside the pack, so the game downloads version %s, tested with DC Universe, from Modrinth (about 200 MB) into the mods folder. Then just restart the game.
